তারিখ: ১০ জ্যৈষ্ঠ, ১৪২৮ বঙ্গাব্দ/২৪ মে, ২০২১ খ্রিষ্টাব্দ

Internal Resources Division: This is the government department responsible for issuing customs and value added tax notifications.
Ministry of Finance: This is the parent ministry governing the Internal Resources Division.
Government of Bangladesh: This is the sovereign authority under which the notification is issued by the relevant ministry.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of this Act empowers the Government to provide exemptions from customs duties for specific goods imported under defined conditions.
Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty A: Section 126(1) of this Act authorizes the government to grant exemptions from value-added tax and supplementary duty in the public interest.
Oil and Gas Exploration and Production E: This order provides customs duty, value-added tax, and supplementary duty exemptions for the import of machinery and equipment intended for oil and gas exploration and production.
The exemption applies to imports by specific state-owned entities under the Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla) and companies operating under Production Sharing Contracts.

Equipment may be imported permanently for authorized operational use or temporarily under a re-export condition, subject to compliance with specific certification, reporting, and disposal requirements.
Items listed in the second schedule that are not directly involved in exploration and production activities are excluded from these duty and tax concessions.
National Board of Revenue: The Board is the authority responsible for overseeing the implementation of these exemptions and must be consulted by the government for such orders.

Importers must provide regular progress and inventory reports to the Board, and prior approval is required for the import of specific vehicles and any potential sale or transfer of duty-exempted goods.
Customs Authority: Customs authorities manage the clearance of imported equipment, receive required certifications and affidavits from importers, and oversee the disposal of damaged or non-functional equipment.
In cases of unauthorized use of duty-exempted goods, the Customs Authority is empowered to take necessary legal action against the importer.

Petrobangla: Petrobangla, also known as the Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation, is the authorized government body that enters into contracts with private institutions for the purpose of oil and gas exploration, extraction, and production activities.
Customs Import Certification: This certification process serves as a formal verification for the import of machinery, spare parts, and other goods by authorized entities. It confirms that the imported items are strictly required for and will be utilized solely in oil and gas exploration, extraction, and production operations as specified in the relevant contractual agreements.

Oil and Gas Exploration and Production E: Imports of machinery, parts, and other goods under specific customs declarations are strictly limited to use for oil and gas exploration, extraction, and production activities.
Importers must provide an undertaking that these goods will not be used or installed for any purpose other than those specified for oil and gas operations.
Customs Act 1969: This act serves as the legal basis for enforcement actions taken if imported goods are used for unauthorized purposes or if specific conditions regarding the handling or re-exportation of the goods are violated.
Customs Duty and Taxes: Importers are contractually obligated to pay all applicable duties and taxes if the imported goods are diverted to unauthorized uses or locations instead of their intended purpose.

পুনঃরপ্তানির শর্তে সাময়িকভাবে আমদানিযোগ্য পণ্যের তালিকা

(ক) ড্রিলিং, ডাইরেকশনাল ড্রিলিং, ওয়ার্কওভার, মাডলগিং, মাড ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং, ওয়ারলাইন লগিং, সিমেন্টেশন, অয়েল টেস্টিং (প্রডাকশন), ডিএসটি, কয়েল টিউবিং, স্নাবিং এবং সাইসমিক/গ্রাভিটি/ম্যাগনেটিক/ অ্যারোম্যাগনেটিক সার্ভিসেস এর যন্ত্রপাতি;

(খ) তেল ও গ্যাস অনুসন্ধান, উত্তোলন ও উৎপাদন কার্যে সরাসরি ব্যবহারযোগ্য জীপ ও পিক-আপ।

Schedule 1: This schedule provides a list of goods that may be temporarily imported under the condition of subsequent re-exportation.
The list is referenced by the third clause of the conditions stipulated in the associated regulatory order.
Temporary Importation: Goods listed in the schedule are eligible for temporary importation provided that they are designated for re-exportation.
The eligibility covers specialized machinery for drilling, exploration, testing, and service operations in the oil and gas sector.
Oil and Gas Exploration Equipment: Various technical equipment and machinery used for oil and gas exploration, extraction, production, and associated services are permitted for temporary import.
Specific service categories include drilling, wireline logging, cementation, production testing, and various seismic or magnetic survey services.
Commercial Vehicles: Jeeps and pick-up trucks used directly in oil and gas exploration, extraction, and production activities are included in the list of goods eligible for temporary importation.

Steel Sheet: This category includes steel plates of a specific thickness and quality standard as per American Standard Testing Method.
Household and Personal Baggage: These items are classified under the specified schedule and are subject to the conditions referenced in the order.
Air Conditioner: Air conditioners with a cooling capacity below a specified British Thermal Unit limit are listed under this schedule.
Anchor Boat: Anchor boats are specified as controlled items under the terms of this schedule.
First Schedule: The First Schedule of the Customs Act 1969 is referenced to define categories of transport vehicles that are excluded from certain concessions when not used directly for oil and gas exploration or production.
Customs Act 1969: The Act serves as the legal basis for the classification of goods and vehicles listed in this schedule.
Communication Equipment: Certain types of cables used for communication and control are included in the restricted list, with specific exclusions for high-voltage power cables.
